authority: Bounded truthful-provenance follow-up; tools owner reported positive native Goal activation proof but exact activation clock unexposed. This defines honest receipt/time convention without inventing a native field.

acceptable_conventions.meaning: Use actual exposed native Goal activation time with source receipt SHA/path/selector and its observed precision. Do not claim finer precision or substitute an updatedAt/completion timestamp.
Use actual host observation/receipt time for positive activation, explicitly labeled observation time rather than exact native event time, with receipt SHA/path/selector.

If exact activation/observation time is genuinely unavailable, retain it as null/UNKNOWN with non-exposure reason. Preserve actual observed same-job stage/native-start lower anchor and actual immutable artifact/proof-freeze upper anchor, source receipt SHA/path/selectors and their clock basis. Positive native Goal activation count/evidence must belong to that job and be bound by those observed anchors. This establishes chronology only; it does not establish exact activation time or elapsed Goal duration.

window_validation: Verify actual anchors and ordering on a stated comparable clock basis and their binding to the positive same-job activation/freeze receipt. Do not use guessed timestamps, model assertions, current file mtime, a later import timestamp mislabeled as original freeze, or ungrounded cross-clock arithmetic. Label any actual later import/proof-freeze anchor as such. A coarse or longer observed window is not an exact event timestamp.
absent_or_unsupported_time_proof: Reject reference admission if no truthful native/host timestamp or supported enclosing observed window is available. Positive Goal count, separate session identity, role/family and exact receipt/data hashes remain mandatory; session alone or an arbitrary time anchor is insufficient.
completion_and_economics: This provenance window is not native COMPLETE-before-deadline evidence, an original stage success, a source grade or observed usage/duration. Retain original failure/HOLD, precise deadline/completion rules and cost unknowns. Never widen a controller clock from this convention.
owner_schema: Tools/ops bind actual exposed receipt fields into the pinned neutral capsule and test explicit unknown exact time with valid window, invented/absent/reversed anchors, session-only evidence and required positive Goal proof. No source/candidate/evaluation bodies, new Goal/probe or extra review gate are required.
